Name: Battleship
Author: Home Deck
Description: Turn two blocks of keys into a real Battleship match. Place your 3-ship fleet (sized down to fit your deck) on your own grid, then fire on the enemy's hidden grid to win. A Turn Indicator key shows whose turn it is, and the enemy's shots land right on your own board a few seconds after yours.

Actions.Name: Fleet Cell
Actions.Tooltip: One square of YOUR fleet grid. Place these in a solid rectangular block on a folder page (3 wide x 4 tall works well). At the start of a game, press a cell to anchor a ship there (it previews extending right or down), use the Turn Indicator to rotate it, then press any previewed cell to confirm. The enemy fires at this grid during its turn.

Actions.Name: Cell
Actions.Tooltip: One square of the ENEMY's hunting grid. Place these in a solid rectangular block on a folder page (3 wide x 4 tall works well). Press a cell to fire at it once you're done placing your own fleet.

Actions.Name: Turn Indicator
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the game's current phase: placing ships, your turn, the enemy's turn, or the match result. During ship placement, pressing this key rotates the ship you're currently positioning. Place one of these near the top-left of your grids.
